project_title: Community-Aware Repository Recommendation and Network-Robustness Analysis in GitHub Collaboration Networks

network_robustness_summary.most_damaging_structural_attack: Betweenness Centrality (GCC reduces to 1.70% at 10% removal, 171 components)
network_robustness_summary.apl_paradox_resolution: APL decrease under severe GCC collapse is condensation/fragmentation, not improved transit.

recommendation_robustness_summary.cf_collapse_at_5pct_degree: Recall@10 drops from 37.90% to 0.00% due to complete elimination of multi-repo developers in training graph (co-occurrence matrix = 0).
recommendation_robustness_summary.community_aware_resilience: Leiden Community-Aware retains 3.09% Recall@10 at 5% degree removal and 4.65% at 10% betweenness removal because community partition remains valid.
recommendation_robustness_summary.matched_baseline_necessity: Survivor cohorts possess different baseline propensities; matched baselines provide unbiased true degradation.
